plan: My private value is $10. In a single-round auction with unknown opponent values, a good strategy is to bid slightly below my true value to maximize potential profit. If I bid too high, I risk paying more than the item is worth to me. If I bid too low, I might lose the item. A reasonable approach is to bid around $9.5 - this gives me a small buffer while still having a good chance of winning.
